independence_basis: Independent Claude Opus 5.5 high review; the auditor did not author request v2, the runner, the bootstrap gate, the source approvals or the operation plan, and performed only the non-writing dry-run, hash computations and git reads, with no connection to any PostgreSQL database.

scope.operation: For a fresh install only: one transactional Gate1 owner closure and item/container catalog import into an already-bootstrapped empty novgorod_world_v17 via --mode v17-local-play, followed by exact readback and a second read-only readback on the same database without a second apply.

review_evidence: At the reviewed head the runner, the fresh-schema execution attestation, the fresh-schema request and all six approved_sources match their request v2 SHA-256 pins.

request_digest was recomputed as sha256 of the key-sorted JSON body without request_digest, as in bootstrap-live-world-v17.mjs, and equals 5409e904...920a. supersedes points to the v1 request, and its digest a95018d0...f6ad was recomputed and matches.
Request v2 differs from v1 only in request_id, runner sha256, runner arguments (v17-local-play), preconditions/execution wording, supersedes and request_digest.

Runner lines 42-48 and 174-183 bind v17-local-play to novgorod_world_v17 and local-play to novgorod_world before any connection or write. The crossed combinations throw PR17_LOCAL_PLAY_EXPECTED_DATABASE_REQUIRED.

In v17-local-play, assertEmptyWorldBase (runner lines 191-221) checks the 27 approved schema source hashes, the exact 208-table set and zero rows in every table. initializeSchema (the 01.sql DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS world_base CASCADE) is reachable only through lines 93 and 108, both guarded by !isV17LocalPlay.

v17-local-play applies once, repeats verifyPromotionState without a second apply, asserts deep equality and records repeat_readback_status exact_match with equal state digests. The shared promotion enforces exact readback and rejects an existing target revision.

The non-writing dry-run at the reviewed head returned pass=true and applied=false, with candidate, approval, amendment, manifest and catalog digests, 39 datasets and 9 status transitions identical to expected_plan v2.

Before the write, bootstrap checks the v2 request digest, the runner pin, the exact runner path and arguments, that attestation v2 exists and that its request_digest equals the v2 digest, the source pins and the dry-run plan, and then invokes only --mode v17-local-play. Integration tests exist for crossed DB modes, missing and mismatched attestation v2, non-v17 schema rejection and fresh v17 success; the reviewer did not run them.
The v1 request, attestation v1, v1 readback and v1 approval-request notes are byte-identical to 8c6b6d3e.
execution_preconditions: Immediately before the write, record and recheck the actual PostgreSQL cluster system identifier and version 16.14, the identity of novgorod_world_v17 and its world_operator ownership, the exact 208 world_base tables, zero rows in every world_base table, and an available offline backup; stop on any drift. The cluster identifier in request v2 describes the original evidence cluster and is not a match target for a fresh install.
Recheck all request v2 pinned source, schema and runner hashes and the request digest, and re-run the non-writing dry-run, comparing all expected_plan digests and counts at execution time.
Execute from a checkout whose runner and all of its transitive imports are identical to reviewed head 1e99ec797fab735e257894fffe5a230e0bb0c906, or obtain a new review.

Use only the request v2 command with --mode v17-local-play --expected-database novgorod_world_v17 and an explicit PR17_TEST_DATABASE_URL naming novgorod_world_v17. Require the built-in rollback probe, a transactional import, an exact first readback, and a second read-only readback with equal state digests.

Before relying on the bootstrap gate, harden assertV17Gate1V2Attestation to also require schema rus.gate1_v17_bootstrap_import_approval.v1, verdict APPROVE or APPROVE_CONDITIONAL, and runner_sha256 and request_path equal to request v2. Until then, the operator confirms these fields manually.
In the change that commits this attestation, update the integration test that expects checkV17BootstrapInputs to reject with V17_GATE1_ATTESTATION_V2_REQUIRED against the real checkout.
Record the actual v17 import readback, the unchanged 208-table schema and the unchanged counts of the existing databases before preparing a separate P12 successor request.

P12 or historical Spatial dataset import
